packs.name: Hip hop
packs.aesthetic: Boom bap: a heavy, saturated kick; a cracking snare with a little room; swung hats; jazzy electric-piano chords and vibes; a round upright-style bass.

packs.name: Trap
packs.aesthetic: Long, saturated 808s; a bright layered clap; crisp hats with rolls; a dark bell melody and a minor pad.

packs.name: Drill
packs.aesthetic: Sliding 808s; a tight, bright snare; triplet hats; a dark minor piano line and string chords.

packs.name: House
packs.aesthetic: A 909-style kick and clap; open offbeat hats and shakers; organ chord stabs; a deep, short bassline.

packs.name: EDM
packs.aesthetic: A big punchy kick; a wide clap with a long room; supersaw chords; a bright pluck lead; a sub bass.

packs.name: Drum & bass
packs.aesthetic: A tight kick and a sharp, high snare; a ride and fast hats; a growling reese bass; airy pads and electric piano.

packs.name: Lo-fi
packs.aesthetic: Dusty, low-passed drums with vinyl crackle; warm, wobbly electric-piano chords; a soft muted-guitar melody; a round bass.

packs.name: Afrobeats
packs.aesthetic: A soft round kick, rims and snaps; shakers; congas, talking drum and bell; a clean highlife guitar; marimba; a bouncing bass.

packs.name: Breakbeat
packs.aesthetic: Roomy break-style drums with ghost snares; a squelchy acid bassline; rave chord stabs and rave piano.

packs.name: R&B
packs.aesthetic: A soft, subby kick; finger snaps and rims; lush electric-piano chords; a sub bass; a sung vocal.

packs.name: Indie rock
packs.aesthetic: A live drum kit (kick, snare, hats, toms, crash); jangly clean guitar chords; driven power chords; a picked bass guitar.

packs.name: Amapiano
packs.aesthetic: The log drum (a woody FM knock-bass that slides) over soft, low-passed kicks; layered, swung shakers; dry rims and claps; congas, woodblock and a whistle; jazzy Rhodes m9 chords; a light piano lick. No vocal ad-libs.

packs.name: Reggaeton
packs.aesthetic: The dembow: a punchy kick and short, boxy snares with a rim on them (several, to switch every four bars); 8th hats; timbales with a roll, güiro; a deep sine sub on the roots; plucks on i–VI–III–VII; a nylon-guitar hook. No vocal ad-libs.

packs.name: Dancehall
packs.aesthetic: A stiff, short, dry kick; hard, dry stick snares and claps (and the stacked Diwali clap); woodblock, toms and a sound-system zap; a short synth-bass riff (the hook); Casio-style riddim stabs; a steel-pan line up high. No vocal ad-libs.

packs.name: UK garage
packs.aesthetic: 2-step: a short, tuned-up kick with midrange punch; talking rimshots, a crisp snare and claps; crisp noise hats, cabasa and a crash; a deep sine sub under an organ bass; M1-style organ m7/m9 stabs; Rhodes chords. No vocal ad-libs (its chopped vocal hook needs your own vocal).

packs.name: Techno
packs.aesthetic: Driven, clipped kicks tuned to G, one with its rumble (a dark reverb tail ducked under the kick); a 909 clap and a bitcrushed one; 16th hats, open hats and a ride; rolling toms; a short off-beat bass; a hypnotic dub stab into a 3/16 echo; an acid line. No vocal ad-libs.

packs.name: Phonk
packs.aesthetic: Memphis to drift: crunchy, tape-degraded 808 drums (kicks, claps, hats with rolls); the tuned 808 cowbell as one-shots and as the lead melody (D minor and its Phrygian ♭2), driven and bit-crushed; a distorted 808; choir-like trance pads. No vocal ad-libs (no pitched-down Memphis vocals).

packs.name: Dubstep
packs.aesthetic: Half-time at 140: sub-heavy kicks; a huge snare (a 190 Hz body, a clap over it, a big room); hats with bursts, a ride, a crash; tambourine and toms; a wobble bass whose LFO rate changes every note over a sub that never moves; a talking growl; dark pads. No vocal ad-libs.

packs.name: Jersey club
packs.aesthetic: Hard, short, clipped kicks for the five-kick bounce; bright claps with short tails; the bed squeak; hats; short 808s with a slide or two; chord stabs cut like a chopped sample; a vocal-chop hook made in code (a formant synth, not a singer). No vocal ad-libs.

packs.name: Synthwave
packs.aesthetic: The night drive: dry 80s drum-machine kicks and hats; bright snares, claps and drum-synth toms in a big room gated shut (the tail stops dead); a tambourine and a machine cowbell; the pulse bass bouncing between octaves on every 8th, and a 16th one; a chorused poly-synth pad and brass stabs on i–VI–III–VII (Am, F, C, G); a 16th pluck arp; a singing saw lead with vibrato. Warm, the top rolled off like tape. No vocal ad-libs.
